title: Arriving at his aunt's apartment in the Sixties
summary: He describes his aunt's rooms off the West Sixties and who stayed with them.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I think she thought he'd -- getting him together out there better. Well, let's go at that point. So you went up to your mother's sister.
So, what -- she had an apartment there?
And she was going out working days?
So, who did she have? Did you have cousins?
No, just her. It was just her there.
Oh. She was glad enough to have you come then, was she?
Oh, and my aunt. She came up with me.

Right. Right. She came up. And, she had, like a -- let me see if I can remember the story -- she had either two rooms and a kitchen. Something like that. But, anyway, I think she stayed there with us.
You know, I just -- . But, I know, I was -- this was in the sixties.
